newsitem.title: USA: TradeLink denies filed Nasdaq application.
newsitem.headline: TradeLink denies filed Nasdaq application.

text.p: TradeLink International Inc Thursday said it has not submitted an application to the Nasdaq Stock Market for quotation.
The company said it was aware of a possible rumor that TradeLink had submitted such an application and that it had been denied by Nasdaq.

TradeLink said it had previously announced that it intends to file a registration statement as quickly as possible following the completion of the audited financial statement for its fiscal year ended March 31, 1997.
